audience: support teams who handle customer tickets in Freshdesk

useCases.title: Find open, urgent or unassigned tickets
useCases.text: The AI searches tickets with the query DSL, for example by status, priority, agent, group or tag. You get a list of what needs attention.

useCases.title: Read a ticket with its replies and notes
useCases.text: The AI reads a ticket and its conversations, public replies and notes. It sums up what happened so far.

useCases.title: Create a ticket for a customer
useCases.text: The AI creates a ticket with subject, description and a requester (email, requester id or phone). It can set status, priority and source.

useCases.title: Reply to a ticket or add an internal note
useCases.text: The AI adds a public reply that is sent to the requester, or a note that is private by default.

useCases.title: Change the status or priority of tickets
useCases.text: The AI finds tickets and updates fields such as status or priority. Only the fields you name are changed.

useCases.title: Look up or add a contact or company
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts by name, email or company, and lists companies. It can create a contact or a company.
